# Accordions

Sections that open one at a time, or each on its own, on the browser's own disclosure - `<details>` and `<summary>`: no script, the keys and the open state built in, and the browser's find in page opens a closed section on a match.

## Examples

Items that share a `name` are one group: opening one closes the one that was open. `open` opens an item from the start.

```html
<div class="accordion">
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic" open>
		<summary class="accordion-header">What does a day trip include?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">The transfer from the hotel, the boat, lunch, snorkelling gear and the park fee.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic">
		<summary class="accordion-header">Can I cancel a booking?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">Free of charge up to 24 hours before the start; later, half the price is kept.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-basic">
		<summary class="accordion-header">Are children welcome?<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">From four years old; under four they travel free.</div>
	</details>
</div>
```

### Each on its own

Without `name` every item opens and closes by itself.

```html
<div class="accordion">
	<details class="accordion-item" open>
		<summary class="accordion-header">Pickup<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">07:30 at the pier, 07:00 from the hotels of Chaweng.</div>
	</details>
	<details class="accordion-item">
		<summary class="accordion-header">What to bring<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
		<div class="accordion-body">Swimwear, a towel and a sunscreen that spares the reef.</div>
	</details>
</div>
```

### Flush

`accordion-flush` drops the frame and the side padding, for sections inside a card or a drawer.

```html
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body">
		<div class="accordion accordion-flush">
			<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-flush" open>
				<summary class="accordion-header">Prices<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
				<div class="accordion-body">Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</div>
			</details>
			<details class="accordion-item" name="accordion-flush">
				<summary class="accordion-header">History<i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i></summary>
				<div class="accordion-body">Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites.</div>
			</details>
		</div>
	</div>
</div>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On a section's header |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens or closes the section; in a group, opening it closes the open one |
| `Tab` | The next header, or the first control inside an open section |

- The header is the `<summary>` itself, which the browser announces as expanded or collapsed. Put no heading inside it: screen readers announce a heading in a summary unevenly. When the sections need a place in the page's outline, a heading goes before the accordion.
- The chevron is decoration, `aria-hidden="true"`; it turns as the section opens.
- A section opens with a short animation only where the browser has `interpolate-size`, and only when the reader allows motion; elsewhere it opens at once.
- From script: `details.open = true`, and the `toggle` event after each change.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/accordion.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/accordion.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accordion-button` | - | remove | the summary is the button; its chevron is <i class="bi bi-chevron-down accordion-icon"> |
| `accordion-collapse` | - | remove | the body follows the summary inside the <details> |
| `accordion-header` | `accordion-header` | review | the item's <summary> with the button's words in it; no heading and no button inside |
| `accordion-item` | `accordion-item` | review | a <details>; the items of one group share a name, as data-bs-parent did |
| `data-bs-parent` | `name` | trigger | the same name on every <details> of the group |
